subject.title: fix(cli): warn that attach --print-config prints a live bearer token

question: Should `attach --print-config` retain live-token stdout with a warning, or must it become log-safe by default before this PR can merge?
rationale: Both choices are technically feasible but create different credential-exposure and compatibility contracts, and no maintainer has confirmed warning-only handling as the permanent boundary.

options.title: Require safe default
options.body: Return the PR for redacted or protected-file output by default, with an explicit warned option if raw bearer output must remain available.

options.title: Accept warning only
options.body: Approve the existing stdout contract and explicitly own the residual risk that users can still copy or capture a live token.

options.title: Defer contract redesign
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve the complete output and handoff design through the canonical issue before changing the CLI.

recommendation.title: Require safe default
recommendation.body: Return the PR for redacted or protected-file output by default, with an explicit warned option if raw bearer output must remain available.

likelyOwner.reason: The token-only design and recent attach security-direction history make this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
